card.name: Words after a duration or in symptom lists
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "after" following "28 days" when back-up contraception continues once an enzyme inducer is stopped. It also fires on a few other words in symptom lists, such as "transient" before worsening.

modes.label: After a duration
modes.description: The word "after" following a number of days, introducing the stopping of a drug.
modes.example: Continue back-up contraception for 28 days<< after>> discontinuing the enzyme inducer to maintain

modes.label: Inside symptom lists
modes.description: A comma, a modifier, or a short word within a list or description of symptoms.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning briefly or temporarily and promotes words like retained and compressed, so it pushes the output away from short-lived wording.
card.plain: It marks the point after a time span or within symptom lists where the text is not about something brief or passing.
